title: A Machine Learning-Based Online Prediction Tool for Predicting Short-Term Postoperative Outcomes Following Spinal Tumor Resections
summary: Among 3,073 patients, the study reports mean AUROC up to 0.745 for prolonged length of stay. Nearest-neighbor imputation was performed before the data split, creating leakage risk; external validation and clinical benefit are not established.
ai_technology: Four machine-learning classifiers predict short-term outcomes after spinal-tumor resection from NSQIP records.
organization: Department of Neurosurgery, Mount Sinai Health System, New York, NY, USA
